scenes.event: Kayla helps Sun work up the courage to ask Yuna out at a local café.
scenes.location: A cozy campus café with soft background music and a few students chatting.
scenes.description: Sun is sitting at a table, nervously fidgeting with her coffee cup. Kayla sits across from her, smiling and trying to ease the tension. Nearby, Yuna is studying with a group of friends, laughing occasionally.

scenes.plot: Kayla helps Sun overcome their anxiety and take the first step in confessing their feelings to Yuna in a public setting.
scenes.social_purpose: To demonstrate the role of friendship in emotional support and personal growth, while showcasing the protagonist's traits and values through natural dialogue and interaction.

chunk.text: Kayla leans forward and gently nudges Sun. 'Come on, Sun. You've been staring at her table for 10 minutes now. What's the worst that could happen?' Sun fidgets with their coffee cup, avoiding eye contact. 'I don't know, Kayla. What if she says no? I don't want to embarrass myself.' Kayla smiles and places a hand on Sun's shoulder. 'Sun, you're not just asking her out—you're being brave. That's what friendship is for: to help each other grow.' Sun takes a deep breath. 'Maybe you're right. But what if I say something awkward?' Kayla leans in closer and grins. 'Then I'll be right here to save you. Just take the first step. You got this!' Sun nods slowly, then stands up and walks toward Yuna's table. 'Okay... here goes nothing.'
